narrative:
Good morning, Pablo Andres. Here is your FY2026 snapshot as of this morning.

**Revenue** — the Q3 forecast is GBP 1,812.9M against the GBP 1,833.3M budget, GBP 20.4M short: Regulated Services handbacks and softer council contact volumes, partly offset by Pension Solutions.

**Adjusted operating margin** is 6.5% in the budget; each point of virtual-agent containment is worth about GBP 2.4M a year.

**Civil Service Pension Scheme** — the contract runs about GBP 28M above revenue; 120 surge FTE can be released from Q4 as automation lands.

**Workforce** — 1,946 FTE required against 2,000 scheduled on the contact-centre estate, with a 22-FTE gap on DWP mornings.

**Pending your decision:** 4 items — advisor redeployment, containment target, CSPS surge release and NLW recovery.

signals.title: Civil Service Pension Scheme: £25–40m profit hit in 2026
signals.source: Capita trading & CSPS contract update — 9 July 2026
signals.excerpt: Surge resourcing, remediation and KPI-related costs are expected to reduce 2026 adjusted operating profit by £25m–£40m, with a £35m–£50m free cash flow impact.

signals.title: Continuing revenue up 1.6% to £906.4m in H1
signals.excerpt: Public Service +2.4% and Pension Solutions +24.7% offset the planned Regulated Services exit; adjusted operating margin 3.6% (H1 2025: 5.3%).

signals.title: Virtual-agent adoption plan — month 3 of 5
signals.source: Capita Contact Centre workforce planning (SDP model)
signals.excerpt: Containment at 18% across about 1,200 customer intents on the 2,000-FTE, 29-contract estate; fall-back-to-human rate 31% on DWP intents.
